usage: The word 法國 is used to refer to the country France.
It can be used as a subject or object in a sentence when talking about France.
You can use 法國 to describe something related to France, like 法國人 (French people).
It often appears in phrases about travel, culture, food, or geography related to France.
Use 法國 when specifying the location or origin in conversations about countries.
